about_the_game:
WELCOME TO YOUR FIRST DEATH.

You're the finest vampire hunter in Octania. That is, until you're bitten by a vampire while escaping the Vampire Overlord's hounds.

But you're not dying. No, you're ​turning​​ — into a vampire, into everything you're not.

I​t's time for your revenge: join the weird vampire chatroom you were invited to and stake the vampire that bit you.  Maybe this will grind your transformation to a halt. 

... It's just your luck that they're hot.

FEATURES

  • An enemies-to-lovers, choice-based branching story with 10+ endings.

    • 3 vampiric love interests (2 male; 1 female). 

    • Love and hate meters chart your feelings and influence your actions towards your vampire love interest!

  • Highly customisable protagonist: name, username, gender, personality, and more! 

    • Pick from 4 unique backstories: The Aristocrat, The Orphan, The Paladin, The Wardog. 

    • Pick from 4 tarot-based vampire hunting guilds: High Priest Hunters, Tower Hunters, Fool Hunters, or Hanged Hunters. 

    • Be part of 1 of 3 vampire clans: Clan Cazenove, Clan von Christ, or Vermin. 

  • ... and customise your online presence in the vampire chatroom!

    • Pick from 10+ avatars... or upload your own for extra realism! 

    • Write your own status, biography, and messages in chat!

  • Voice and video call the chatroom's vampires, listen to voice messages, get them to accept your friend requests, and more!

  • Dynamic choice system: choose what to do while exploring Octania… 

  • Custom-made OST and sound effects.

  • Accessibility options (autovoicing, alt hyperlegible font, etc.)

short_description: You need to stake the vampire that bit you. Hunt down your enemy, kiss them maybe, and fall in hate (& love) in our dark romance Vampire Hunter x Vampire dating chatsim. Customise your Hunter, descend into a gothic urban dystopia, and dance with the devil with our 3 dangerous love interests...
